note: Reads state/progress.json, sets status='error' and updated_at=api.nowIso, writes back via temp+rename (with graceful fallback to writeJson if api.state.rename is unavailable), then appends {timestamp, iteration, event:'error', summary:'orchestration node error'} to state/iteration_log.jsonl. Returns label 'ok' on success; returns label 'error' if progress.json is missing/invalid or any unexpected exception occurs. No imports, no timers, no Date.now(); timestamp sourced solely from api.nowIso.
